paragraphs.text: Right-to-left chat layout for DeepSeek Harness (Persian/Arabic)
# dsh-rtl

Right-to-left, right-aligned text for DeepSeek Harness chat —
built for Persian and Arabic conversat
ions that the default LTR transcript renders badly.
فارسی · English

A small DSH profile bundle: a Host half that does nothing, plus a Client module that
registers one s

tylesheet and removes it on dispose. No fork of the harness, no patched
artifacts, no DOM rewriting.
## What it changes
| Surface | Before | After |

| Assistant messages (Markdown) | LTR, left-aligned | RTL, right-aligned |
| User message bubble | L

TR, left-aligned | RTL, right-aligned |
| Lists inside messages | marker on the left, indent on the

left | marker on the right, mirrored indent |
| Code blocks, inline code, KaTeX | LTR | LTR, and `un

icode-bidi: isolate` so their punctuation cannot reorder the sentence |
| Composer | LTR | RTL while

i: isolate` so their punctuation cannot reorder the sentence |
| Composer | LTR | RTL while typing |

The sidebar, tab strip, toolbars, and Settings keep their own direction; the stylesheet is
scoped to
the transcript and the composer.
## Install
The bundle is installed the same way as any other DSH plugin — no build step.
### From this repository

1. **Plugins** in the left sidebar → **Add plugin**.
2. Paste the repository address: `https://githu

b.com/hami-ashraafi/dsh-rtl`
3. Install, then switch **Right-to-left Chat** on.
### From a local checkout

1. **Plugins** → **Add plugin**.
2. Paste the absolute path of this directory.
3. Install, then swit
ch **Right-to-left Chat** on.
Restart DeepSeek Harness if the manager reports `restart-required`.
## Uninstall
**Plugins** → **Right-to-left Chat** → **Remove**.
## How it works

- `dsh.bundle.patch` makes this package a **bundle**: `cordis.patch.yml` inserts the
`dsh-rtl` row i

nto the profile composition.
- `dsh.client` makes the Client module load with the Web UI at boot.

`client.js` is a lazy factory registered into `window.__ModuleLoader__.load` — the same
contract eve
ry shipped DSH client plugin uses:

### Selectors

DSH class names are CSS-module hashes, so the stylesheet matches the stable parts instead:
the `data

-slot="conversation.chat.flow"` transcript anchor, the `data-chat-turn` rows, the
`data-conversation

-scroll` container, class names that contain `markdown` or `bubble`, and
`[data-composer-seat]` for

the editor. If a future Harness release renames one of them, the
fix is a one-line selector change i

a future Harness release renames one of them, the
fix is a one-line selector change in `client.js`.
## Compatibility

Written against DSH `0.2.1-rc.3` (Desktop and Web). It touches only presentation, so a
release that
changes no chat DOM keeps working.
## Connecting it to the Harness project

The harness repository ships **no** RTL or bidi handling of its own — this repository exists
to fill
that gap. It follows the project's documented path for community plugins:

- the repository carries the `dsh-plugin` topic, which
the Harness README names as the discoverabili

ty mechanism;
- it is announced in
DeepSeek Harness Discussions #11672,
which the project uses inste

- it is announced in
DeepSeek Harness Discussions #11672,
which the project uses instead of issues.

The upstream repository has issues and pull requests disabled, so this is distributed as a
standalon

e bundle rather than a patch to the harness sources. The same plugin is also staged
in the upstream

package shape under `upstream/` — `packages/client/ui-rtl`
with the repository's TypeScript, tsconfi

g, and `?inline` CSS conventions — ready to apply if
that repository starts accepting contributions.
